From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation plan — Helion Health pilot (confirm goals & timeline)

Hi Nina / Sam —

Thanks again for the time last week. I'd like to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) and evaluation plan so we all have clarity on goals, success criteria, owners, and the path to a pilot close. Proposed first pass below.

High-level goals (please confirm or adjust):
- Run a 4-week pilot on Redwood Dedicated with anonymized EHR snippets to validate latency and cost per token against your inference SLA.
- Surface embedding-based search improvements for clinician triage (50% faster retrieval in our internal benchmark).
- Produce an evaluation report with perf, quality regressions, and rollout recommendations.

Proposed timeline (flexible):
- Week of Jul 12: Kickoff + environment access and data checklist
- Week of Jul 19: Integration + smoke tests (1–2 sample endpoints)
- Week of Jul 26: Full pilot run + quality evals
- Week of Aug 2: Results review and next-steps (decision to expand / purchase)

Suggested owners:
- Champion / business: Nina Gupta (Helion)
- Technical lead: Sam Torres (Helion)
- AE / commercial: Rishi Malhotra (Redwood) — me
- CSM / onboarding: Marissa Cole (Redwood) — looping her in next
- Solutions engineering: Monica Patel (Redwood) — for integration & perf checks

Attachments: I attached a blank MAP template (redwood_map_template.pdf) to capture milestones and acceptance criteria. Also happy to convert this into a shared doc once we agree on dates.

Can you confirm: (1) that the goals above match your expectations, (2) who will be the approver for procurement, and (3) whether Jul 12 or Jul 13 works for a 45-min kickoff?

Thanks — I’ll hold a placeholder on my calendar after I hear which date works for you.

—
